name: GM Financial (Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, Cadillac)
notes: Researched from public gmfinancial.com pages only (no sign-in). MyAccount sign-in uses an email address (the login page says the login process changed to email). Online payments and Auto Pay draw a bank account; card payments are only possible through Western Union or MoneyGram (their fees), so online methods are bank-only. Agent-assisted phone payments go through ACI Payments for $2.50 or $3.50 and must be under $3,000. Auto Debit is a separate mailed/emailed form program; cancelling it needs a call at least 5 days before the due date, while MyAccount Auto Pay can be turned off online. There is no grace period. Payment arrangements / moving a payment to the end of a retail contract are handled by messaging or calling the Customer Experience team, not a self-service form, so payment_arrangement is unsupported online.

autopay.note: Enroll in Auto Pay in MyAccount; the separate Auto Debit program uses a form and takes at least 10 days to start.

autopay_cancel.note: Turn off Auto Pay in MyAccount; Auto Debit must be cancelled by phone at least 5 days before the due date.

payment_arrangement.note: Moving a payment or setting up an arrangement is not self-service. Message the Customer Experience team in MyAccount or call 1-800-284-2271 to see if your account qualifies.

pay_by_phone.note: ACI Payments phone payments cost $2.50 or $3.50 and must be under $3,000.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Make one-time payments or set up Auto Pay in MyAccount or the GM Financial Mobile app from a bank account. Agent-assisted phone payments through ACI Payments at 1-800-284-2271 cost $2.50 or $3.50, must be under $3,000 and can take up to 2 business days to post.

By mail, send a check or money order payable to GM Financial with your payment coupon to P.O. Box 650595, Dallas, TX 75265-0595. Cash and card payments are possible only through Western Union or MoneyGram, which charge their own fees.

help.title: Auto Pay and Auto Debit
paragraphs: Auto Pay is set up in MyAccount and schedules your payments automatically; you can turn it off there too.

Auto Debit is a separate program: send the Automatic Payment Plan form with a voided check by mail, email or fax. It takes at least 10 days to start, and to cancel it you call 1-800-284-2271 at least 5 days before your due date.

help.title: Paying with cash or a credit card
paragraphs: Pay cash at Western Union Quick Collect or MoneyGram locations, or pay by credit card through Western Union or MoneyGram; they charge a fee, GM Financial does not. For MoneyGram use receive code 2583 for a purchase account or 12424 for a lease. Western Union online payments made before 5 p.m. CT post the same business day.

help.title: Is there a grace period?
paragraphs: No. Interest and any late fees accrue daily after the due date as set by your contract.

help.title: Payment assistance
paragraphs: Some accounts qualify for moving a payment to the end of a retail contract or another arrangement. Customers facing hardship or a natural disaster can message, text or call the Customer Experience team to talk about options.

help.title: Paperless statements
paragraphs: Turn on paperless statements in your MyAccount or mobile app profile settings to get a notice when each statement is online. Digital statements are often ready before paper ones arrive.

extra.intent: Using the GM Financial website's help pages, find the maximum amount allowed for a phone payment through ACI Payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Phone payments through ACI Payments must be under $3,000.

extra.intent: Using GM Financial's help pages, find the MoneyGram receive code for paying a GM Financial purchase (retail) account in cash. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: The MoneyGram receive code for a purchase account is 2583.
